en.headline: Observatory forecasts temperatures falling to 16 degrees midweek
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory said a northeast monsoon would bring cooler weather from Tuesday, with urban temperatures between 16 and 20 degrees on Wednesday.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said a northeast monsoon was expected to reach the south China coast on Tuesday morning, bringing cooler conditions and rain.

According to the Observatory's 9-day forecast updated at 4.50am today, Tuesday would be cloudy with a few rain patches and becoming cool, with temperatures between 18 and 23 degrees. On Wednesday, temperatures would range from 16 to 20 degrees, remaining cool in the morning and at night under cloudy skies with one or two rain patches.
No weather warning is currently in force. The Observatory advised the public to stay warm as the weather turns cooler midweek, particularly in the New Territories where temperatures could be lower.
Conditions are expected to improve towards the end of the week as the monsoon moderates, with temperatures rising and larger day-night differences.

zh.headline: 天文台預料周中氣溫跌至16度
zh.dek: 香港天文台表示，東北季候風明日抵達華南沿岸，周三市區氣溫介乎16至20度，早晚清涼。
body: 天文台表示，一股東北季候風預料明日早上抵達華南沿岸，天氣將轉涼並有雨。
根據天文台今日清晨4時50分更新的九天天氣預報，星期二多雲，有幾陣雨，天氣轉涼，氣溫介乎18至23度。星期三氣溫介乎16至20度，多雲，有一兩陣雨，早晚清涼。
目前沒有天氣警告生效。天文台建議市民在周中天氣轉涼時注意保暖，新界地區氣溫可能更低。
周末季候風稍為緩和後，天氣預料改善，氣溫回升，日夜溫差較大。
